parameters.name: AssertKey
parameters.description:
The type of the log subscription. Valid values:

*   **risk**: risk information.
*   **event**: attack event information.
*   **asset**: asset information.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: LogRegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region where logs are stored.

>  You can call the [DescribeUserSlsLogRegions](~~2712598~~) operation to query available log storage regions.

parameters.name: LogStoreName
parameters.description:
The name of the Logstore in Simple Log Service.

>  API security logs can be delivered only to Logstores whose names start with apisec-.

parameters.name: ProjectName
parameters.description:
The name of the project in Simple Log Service.

>  API security logs can be delivered only to projects whose names start with apisec-.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: Chinese mainland.
*   **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi modify-apisec-log-delivery --instance-id waf_v3_public_cn-uqm2z00000a --assert-key risk --log-region-id cn-hangzhou --project-name apisec-project-1431657200000000 --log-store-name apisec-logstore000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
